title: Tools for Specialist Work, Designed and Built
subtitle: AI tools where the person stays in control, built with the people who use them

bio.short: I design software for people doing specialist work, and I build it myself with AI coding agents. At Bibel TV I built an AI Bible chat app end to end. I also gave the viewer-services team an AI assistant where every send decision stays human. At ChurchDesk and Ninox I turned expert workflows into product capabilities.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV, a broadcaster moving from linear TV to apps, I was Head of Product Design, and much of the work was building. The viewer-services team answers letters, emails and social messages. I designed a Microsoft Copilot skill that drafts from their support handbook and ran the introduction myself, with a self-test week and one-to-one sessions. Every send decision stays with the person. Complex letters now take minutes instead of hours.

I also built an AI Bible chat app for Bibel TV end to end in about two months. I designed and directed it; AI coding agents implemented it. It spans iOS and Android apps with a web sibling, a server with chat and RAG, and a sermon-video pipeline that produces source-linked clips. The existing logs held a start point per verse reference but no end; I added the end. Underneath sits a design system I built as an API, with four token tiers for iOS, Android, web and connected TV. A test pipeline I built runs 2,195 unit, contract and snapshot tests.

At ChurchDesk I owned product management for the main platform. A customer asked for funeral booking. After validation with pastors and funeral directors, I built booking into the platform calendar instead of a standalone add-on. It rolled out to every customer. In a freelance engagement in summer 2025, I designed Ninox's AI onboarding with the CEO. The generated database stays editable, because people describe their work briefly.

context.company: b'steuern combines a tax practice with its own software and AI agents, built in-house next to the tax team.
context.role: UI/UX Engineer: designs and builds internal tools, the human–agent layer and the client experience, takes them live, and builds the design system.
context.emphasis: Lead with human-in-control AI for an internal team and with building the tool himself. Then expert-workflow judgment (ChurchDesk, Ninox) and the design system built as code.
